en: Dependent on a state that is with conflict (*saraṇa*) and defiled (*saṅkiliṭṭha-saṅkilesika*), a state that is without conflict (*na-saraṇa*) and not defiled (*na-saṅkiliṭṭha-saṅkilesika*) arises by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*). [Under] the root condition there is one; ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition there is one.

Dependent on a state that is without conflict and defiled, a state that is neither without conflict nor not defiled arises by way of the root condition. Dependent on a state that is without conflict and defiled, a state that is without conflict...

A non-defiled-non-defiling state arises conditioned by a root-condition. Under root-conditions there are two; ... [and so on] ... under resultant-conditions there is one; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance-conditions there are two.

Dependent on a state that is without conflict, non-defiled, and non-defiling, a state that is without refuge, non-defiled, and non-defiling arises conditioned by a root-condition. Under root-conditions there is one; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance-conditions there is one.
